Northeast Investment Management Has Lifted Position in Intuitive Surgical (ISRG) as Valuation Rose; Jpmorgan Chase & Co. (JPM) Valuation Rose While Sol Capital Management Co Cut Position
May 22, 2018 - By Kurt Siggers
Northeast Investment Management increased its stake in Intuitive Surgical Inc (ISRG) by 372.85% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Northeast Investment Management bought 8,542 shares as the company’s stock rose 11.58% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 10,833 shares of the health care company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $3.95M, up from 2,291 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Northeast Investment Management who had been investing in Intuitive Surgical Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $52.50B market cap company. The stock increased 1.00% or $4.59 during the last trading session, reaching $463.38. About 485,637 shares traded. Intuitive Surgical, Inc. (NASDAQ:ISRG) has risen 58.43% since May 22, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 46.88% the S&P500.
Christopher Pucillo decreased its stake in Jpmorgan Chase & Co. (JPM) by 18.84% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Sol Capital Management Co sold 5,750 shares as the company’s stock rose 0.67% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by Christopher Pucillo held 24,770 shares of the major banks company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $2.65M, down from 30,520 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Sol Capital Management Co who had been investing in Jpmorgan Chase & Co. for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $381.79B market cap company. The stock increased 0.92% or $1.02 during the last trading session, reaching $112.15. About 9.44 million shares traded. JPMorgan Chase & Co. (NYSE:JPM) has risen 23.99% since May 22, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 12.44% the S&P500.
